text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"--"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE:- 1) PROFILE CUTTING SHOULD BE DONE. 2) TO BE CASE CARBURISING DONE. 2) TO BE INDUCTION HARDENED UPTO 50 ~ 55 HRC. 3) CASE DEPTH 0.8~ 1.2 mm."}],"comment":"The title block heat treatment field is '--' while note N3 specifies case carburising and induction hardening, but neither states the manufacturing stage at which each treatment applies (e.g., before or after finish machining). This ambiguity can cause the shop to apply treatments in the wrong order, ruining dimensional accuracy or hardness. The designer should update the heat treatment field and notes to clearly state the sequence and stage for each treatment.","recommended_correction":"Update the heat treatment field and add a note specifying that profile cutting is done first, followed by case carburising, then finish machining, and finally induction hardening of the indicated area."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D4","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 6 H7 (+0.012/0)"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D5","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 14 H7 (+0.018/0)"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"Holes F1 (D4) and F2 (D5) carry tight H7 tolerances, yet the part requires I.Z.B.P. plating per the title block with no allowance or instruction for masking or post-plating sizing. Plating buildup inside these holes will reduce their diameters and break the H7 fit, preventing mating pins or shafts from assembling. The designer should add a note specifying that these holes are to be masked during plating or that the H7 tolerance applies after plating.","recommended_correction":"Add a note such as 'Ø6 H7 AND Ø14 H7 HOLES TO BE MASKED DURING PLATING' or specify that the H7 tolerance applies after plating."}]}
